reasoning.step_3_getScopeString: Apply DCSC.L200 filter (drop instanceof ClientModel): removes the adv2-client ClientModel. The ClientScope named 'adv2-client' is a ClientScopeModel and is NOT removed. Apply isIncludeInTokenScope filter: per realm-config, include.in.token.scope = false on basic / acr / roles / web-origins / adv2-scope-attr-false (these drop); = true on adv2-scope-attr-true / adv2-client (scope) / email / profile (these keep); attribute absent on adv2-scope-attr-unset → defaults true (keeps). Result set = {profile, email, adv2-scope-attr-true, adv2-client, adv2-scope-attr-unset}. attachOIDCScope prepends 'openid' because the auth-session SCOPE note ('openid') is an OIDC request and openid is not already present.

The order of {profile, email, adv2-scope-attr-true, adv2-client, adv2-scope-attr-unset} is HashSet iteration order over ClientScopeModel hash codes — invariant 10 declares this not contract-derivable.
